title: KineFX or VAT real-time animation packaging
summary: Validate identity, rest pose, topology, clip ranges, and engine profile before producing a synchronized skeletal or VAT artifact bundle.

use_when: animated geometry must play through bones or VAT in a game engine
avoid_when: the deliverable is only a Houdini cache or offline render

inputs: animated geometry/skeleton with explicit identity and topology policy
FPS, ranges, clips, units, axes, and engine exporter profile
acceptance: rest pose or VAT topology contract passes
all artifacts share one source revision
engine playback evidence is recorded when required
rollback: export to a new versioned directory
